blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to enrich user queries in information retrieval (IR) so that a standard retriever such as BM25 can bridge vocabulary gaps with the target corpus. Any single LLM, however, is limited by its training data and architectural biases, and its enrichment behavior depends on hand-crafted prompts that must be re-engineered for each new model—an expensive and poorly scalable process. We present MERGE ( Multi-LLM Ensemble for Retrieval via Generative Enrichment ), a two-stage framework: three heterogeneous 7–8B open-source LLMs independently produce candidate expansions, and a larger LLM generatively synthesizes them into a single query. To make prompt engineering scalable across the ensemble, we integrate a task-grounded Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO) loop into both stages. Unlike APO methods that judge candidates with an LLM evaluator, our loop scores each candidate by its downstream retrieval performance and runs a small tournament between the current champion prompt and optimizer-proposed drafts, terminating once the champion survives two consecutive rounds; a history-augmented variant additionally feeds the recent tournament trajectory back to the optimizer. MERGE is retriever-agnostic and issues a single BM25 pass with no rank fusion, no supervised document expansion, and no re-indexing. On five BEIR benchmarks (NQ, SciFact, FiQA, Touché-2020, DBPedia), MERGE improves BM25 nDCG@10 over the original queries by + 2.1 +2.1 to + 14.9 +14.9 points and matches or outperforms strong LLM-based query-expansion baselines despite using only compact open-source models. Ablations confirm that the Stage-2 ensemble beats any single Stage-1 LLM, and that task-grounded APO converts large seed-prompt regressions into consistent gains without hand-tuning.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地用于丰富信息检索(IR)中的用户查询,这样像BM25这样的标准检索器就可以与目标体弥补词汇空白. 然而,任何单一的LLM都受到其培训数据和建筑偏差的限制,其浓缩行为取决于手动的提示,而这种提示必须为每个新模型重新设计——一个昂贵和难以扩展的过程。 我们提出MERGE(通过基因浓缩进行检索的多LLM集),一个分为两个阶段的框架:三个不同的7-8B开源LLMs独立产生候选扩展,一个更大的LLM基因合成一个单一的查询. 为了使工程能迅速跨越综艺圈,我们把一个任务定位的自动快速优化循环(APO)整合到两个阶段. 与使用LLM评价员对候选人进行评判的APO方法不同,我们的循环按每个候选人的下游检索性能进行评分,并在目前冠军迅速和优化提议的草稿之间进行小规模的联赛,一旦冠军连续两轮存活下来就终止;一个历史强化的变体又将最近的联赛轨迹反馈给优化者。 MERGE是检索器-不可知的,并颁发单BM25的传球,没有军衔组合,没有监督文件扩展,也没有重新索引. 在五个BEIR基准(NQ,SciFact,FiQA,Touché-2020,DBPedia)上,MERGE将BM25 nDCG@10比最初的查询改进为+2.1+2.1到+14.9+14.9分,并匹配或超越了强大的基于LLM的查询扩展基线,尽管只使用紧凑的开源模型. 缩写证实阶段-2综艺优于任何单一阶段-1 LLM,任务定位的APO将大型种子速率回归转换为一致的增益而不进行手调.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become central components of modern information retrieval (IR) pipelines ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) . For query-side enrichment in particular, methods such as Query2Doc ( Wang et al., 2023a ) and HyDE ( Gao et al., 2023 ) use an LLM to generate pseudo-documents or hypothetical answers that clarify user intent and improve retrieval. The common thread is contextual query enrichment : an LLM rewrites the user query so that a downstream retriever—often a strong lexical retriever such as BM25—can more easily match it with relevant passages.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)已成为现代信息检索(IR)管道(Zhu et al., 2023)的中心组成部分. 特别是对于查询侧浓缩,Query2Doc(Wang等人,2023a)和HyDE(Gao等人,2023年)等方法使用LLM生成伪文件或假设答案,澄清用户意图和改进检索. 常见的线程是上下文查询丰富:LLM重写用户查询,这样下游检索器——常常是BM25等强词典检索器——可以更容易地与相关段落匹配.

blocks.en: Two problems limit the practical impact of this line of work. First, LLMs inherit biases and blind spots from their training data and architecture ( Bender et al., 2021 ) , so a single model tends to produce enrichments with a distinctive but narrow style—missing rephrasings, hallucinating details, or over-committing to a specific interpretation of an ambiguous query. Second, controlling enrichment behavior relies heavily on hand-crafted prompts, and prompts that work well for one model family (e.g., Qwen2.5) transfer poorly to another (e.g., Llama-3.3 or Mistral) without a further round of manual tuning. This burden grows with the number of LLMs one wishes to combine, making multi-LLM ensembles hard to scale and hard to justify on cost grounds.
blocks.zh: 有两个问题限制了这项工作的实际影响。 首先,LLMS继承了他们的训练数据和架构中的偏差和盲点(Bender等人,2021年),因此,单一的模型往往产生具有独特但狭义风格的浓缩物——缺失重写,幻觉细节,或者过多地对模糊的查询作出具体解释. 第二,控制浓缩行为严重依赖手工制作的提示,而提示对于一个模型家族(如Quen2.5)来说效果良好的传递到另一个模型家族(如Llama-3.3或Mistral),没有再进行一轮人工调试. 这一负担随着人们希望合并的法学硕士课程数目而增加,使多种法学硕士课程难以推广,也难以以成本理由证明合理。

blocks.en: We address both problems with MERGE ( Multi-LLM Ensemble for Retrieval via Generative Enrichment ). MERGE processes an input query x x through two stages, illustrated in Figure 1 : • Generation. Multiple heterogeneous LLMs independently produce enriched query candidates y 1 , … , y n y_{1},\dots,y_{n} , exposing diverse but complementary views of the user’s intent. Each generator uses a prompt that has been automatically specialized to its own model. • Ensemble. An LLM generatively synthesizes { y 1 , … , y n } \{y_{1},\dots,y_{n}\} into a single unified query expansion y ^ \hat{y} , filtering likely hallucinations and merging complementary information under an APO-tuned ensemble prompt.

blocks.en: MERGE embodies dual-level ensemble : horizontal ensemble across heterogeneous generators within Stage 1, and vertical ensemble across the specialized Stage-1 / Stage-2 pipeline ( Dietterich, 2000 ) . Compared to selection-based fusion ( Jiang et al., 2023b ; Tekin et al., 2024 ) it retains full generative flexibility; compared to single-stage LLM expansion ( Wang et al., 2023a ; Gao et al., 2023 ) it explicitly separates producing diverse candidates from synthesizing them.
blocks.zh: MERGE体现了双重层次的组合:第1阶段内跨不同发电机的横向组合和跨专门阶段1/阶段2管道的垂直组合(Dietrich,2000年)。 与基于选择的聚变(Jiang等人,2023b;Tekin等人,2024)相比,它保留了完全的基因灵活性;与单阶段LLM扩展(Wang等人,2023a;Gao等人,2023)相比,它明确将产生多种候选者与合成它们区分开来.

blocks.en: To address the scalability concern above, we integrate a task-grounded Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO) loop into both stages of MERGE. Starting from hand-crafted seed prompts, our APO loop iteratively rewrites and evolves each generator’s prompt and the ensemble prompt under a retrieval-driven objective; each LLM ultimately runs with a prompt specialized to itself rather than a one-size-fits-all template. Unlike prior APO methods that rely on an LLM judge, our loop scores each candidate prompt by its actual retrieval performance on a small labelled subset and feeds this numerical signal, together with the history of previously tried prompts, back into the optimizer LLM. As a result, adding a new LLM to the generation stage no longer requires manual prompt engineering, and improvements in one LLM’s prompt do not silently degrade the ensemble’s behavior. Since APO is applied once and reused, its optimization cost is amortized over all downstream retrieval runs.
blocks.zh: 为解决上述可扩展性问题,我们将基于任务的自动快速优化循环(APO)纳入MERGE的两个阶段. 从手工制作的种子提示开始,我们的APO循环迭代重写并进化了每个生成器的提示和在检索驱动目标下的组合提示;每个LLM最终以专用于自身的提示而不是一刀切的模板运行. 与以往依赖LLM判断的APO方法不同,我们的循环通过每个候选人的实际检索性能,在小的标签子集上对每个候选人进行迅速的评分,并将这个数值信号与以前尝试过的提示历史一起反馈到优化器LLM中. 因此,在生成阶段添加一个新的LLM不再需要人工即时工程,一个LLM的即时改进不会默默地贬低综艺的行为. 由于APO一次应用并再利用,其优化成本被摊销到所有下游检索运行中.

blocks.en: We evaluate MERGE on five diverse BEIR benchmarks ( Thakur et al., 2021 ) —NQ ( Kwiatkowski et al., 2019 ) , SciFact ( Wadden et al., 2020 ) , FiQA ( Maia et al., 2018 ) , Touché-2020 ( Bondarenko et al., 2020 ) , and DBPedia ( Hasibi et al., 2017 ) —covering open-domain QA, scientific claim verification, financial opinion QA, argument retrieval, and entity retrieval. Our contributions are as follows: • We propose MERGE, an IR-focused two-stage LLM ensemble that enriches user queries by combining heterogeneous multi-LLM generation with a generative ensemble step. • We introduce a task-grounded APO loop that scores candidate prompts by their actual downstream retrieval performance rather than by an LLM judge, and apply it to both stages of MERGE. This turns per-LLM prompt engineering from a manual, non-scalable step into an automatic, model-specific optimization. • MERGE is retriever-agnostic: its output is a plain-text query that can be fed to any retriever. Across five BEIR datasets, MERGE-enriched queries improve BM25 retrieval over the original queries on all five benchmarks and match or outperform strong LLM-based query-expansion baselines, with ablations that isolate the contributions of the ensemble stage and of APO. We adopt BM25 as the shared retrieval backbone in our experiments, matching the standard setup used in prior LLM-based query-expansion work, so that measured gains reflect how the query is manipulated rather than a jointly trained retriever.
blocks.zh: 我们根据五个不同的BEIR基准(Thakur等人,2021年)评价MERGE——NQ(Kwiatkowski等人,2019年),SciFact(Wadden等人,2020年),FiQA (Maia等人,2018年),Touché-2020(Bondarenko等人,2020年)和DBPedia (Hasibi等人,2017年)——覆盖开放域QA,科学索赔核实,财务意见QA,论证检索,实体检索. • 我们的贡献如下: 我们提议使用MERGE,这是一个以IR为重点的两阶段LLM组合,通过将多种多LLM生成与基因组合步骤相结合,丰富用户的查询。 我们引入了一个基于任务的APO循环,通过候选人的实际下游检索性能而不是LLM法官来评分,并将其应用于MERGE的两个阶段. 这使得每个LLM的即时工程从一个手工的,不可缩放的步骤转变为自动的,模型特有的优化. · MERGE是检索器-不可知的:其输出是一个纯文本查询,可以提供给任何检索器。 在整个五个BERR数据集中,MERGE浓缩的查询比所有五个基准的原始查询改进了BM25的检索,并匹配或超过了基于LLM的强力查询-扩展基线,同时进行模拟,将综艺阶段和APO的贡献隔离开来。 我们采用BM25作为我们实验中的共享检索主干线,匹配之前基于LLM的查询-扩展工作所使用的标准设置,这样,测量得分反映查询是如何被操纵的,而不是联合训练的检索器.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recent surveys ( Lu et al., 2024 ) categorize LLM ensembles into ensemble-before-inference (routing ( Shnitzer et al., 2023 ; Ong et al., 2024 ) ), during-inference (token-level fusion ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Mavromatis et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) ), and after-inference (response-level selection ( Li et al., 2024 ; Guha et al., 2024 ) or regeneration ( Jiang et al., 2023b ; Tekin et al., 2024 ) ). LLM-Blender ( Jiang et al., 2023b ) pioneered selection-then-regeneration, LLM-TOPLA ( Tekin et al., 2024 ) maximizes response diversity in selection, and self-consistency ( Wang et al., 2023b ) majority-votes over reasoning paths. MERGE falls into the ensemble-after-inference family and is distinctive in (a) targeting IR enrichment specifically and (b) tuning every prompt in the ensemble automatically via task-grounded APO with a retrieval objective.
blocks.zh: 近期调查(Lu等人,2024年)将LLM 共聚物分类为共聚物前推论(途径(Shnitzer等人,2023年;Ong等人,2024年)),推论期间(托肯级聚变(Huang等人,2024年;Mavromatis等人,2024年;Xu等人,2025年)),推论后推论(反应级选择(Li等人,2024年;Guha等人,2024年)或再生(Jiang等人,2023b;Tekin等人,2024年)),LLLM-Blender(Jiang等人,2023b),在当时的再生中率先选择,LLM-TOPLA(Tekin等人,2024年),在选择中最大限度地实现反应多样性,自我共性(Wang等人,2023b)在推理路径上占多数。 MERGE属于综艺后推论家族,其独特之处在于(a) 具体针对IR浓缩,(b) 通过任务定位的APO自动调整综艺中的每个提示,并具有检索目标。

blocks.en: Classical query expansion uses relevance feedback ( Rocchio, 1971 ) and embedding-based extensions ( Kuzi et al., 2016 ) . Recent LLM-based methods—Query2Doc ( Wang et al., 2023a ) , HyDE ( Gao et al., 2023 ) , and Exp4Fuse ( Liu and Zhang, 2025 ) —use a single LLM to rewrite the query, with Exp4Fuse additionally fusing two BM25 ranked lists; we use these as our main baselines. doc2query ( Nogueira et al., 2019 ; Gospodinov et al., 2023 ) and docT5query ( Nogueira and Lin, 2019 ) target the same query–corpus vocabulary gap but use a supervised T5 fine-tuned on MS MARCO to generate query-like text from each document , requiring corpus access and re-indexing when the corpus changes. Closely related is BEATS ( Shih et al., 2026 ) , a multi-stage LLM pipeline that enriches the corpus side of e-commerce search through a human-in-the-loop prompt-refinement cycle. MERGE targets the same vocabulary gap without supervision or corpus access—operating on the user query only with zero-shot LLMs—and removes BEATS’s human step by grounding prompt refinement in downstream retrieval scores.
blocks.zh: 古典查询扩展使用相关反馈(Rocchio,1971年)和嵌入式扩展(Kuzi等人,2016年). 最近基于LLM的方法—— 腾讯2Doc(Wang等人,2023a),HyDE(Gao等人,2023),Exp4Fuse(Liu and Zhang,2025)——使用单一LLM重写查询,Exp4Fuse额外引信两个BM25排名列表;我们用这些作为主要基线. doc2query(Nogueira等人,2019年;Gospodinov等人,2023年)和docT5query(Nogueira和Lin,2019年)针对相同的查询-公司词汇缺口,但使用MS MARCO上一个有监督的T5微调生成每个文档的类似查询文本,要求实体访问和在程序变更时重新索引. 密切相关的是BEAATS(Shih等人,2026年),这是一个多阶段LLM管道,它通过人-在-在-在-在-即时-精炼循环中丰富电子商务搜索的精准方面. MERGE针对的是同样的词汇缺口, 没有监督或实体访问—— 只在用户查询时使用零镜头的LLMs—— 并且通过在下游检索分数中迅速进行改进来删除BEATS的人的步骤。

blocks.en: APO methods treat prompts as optimizable objects: ProTeGi ( Pryzant et al., 2023 ) uses LLM-produced “textual gradients”; APE ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) and OPRO ( Yang et al., 2024 ) cast prompt design as black-box optimization; evolutionary variants EvoPrompt ( Guo et al., 2024 ) and Promptbreeder ( Fernando et al., 2023 ) maintain a prompt population; SPO ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) removes label supervision by using an LLM evaluator over pairs of outputs. Recent surveys ( Ramnath et al., 2025 ) cover the space. Our loop builds on SPO but replaces the LLM evaluator with the actual downstream IR score on a small labelled subset, and feeds that numerical signal—together with the history of previously tried prompts—back into the optimizer LLM (§ 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: APO 方法将提示作为可选对象: ProTeGi(Pryzant等人,2023年)使用LLM制成的"文字梯度";APE(Zhou等人,2023年)和OPRO(Yang等人,2024年)将即时设计作为黑箱优化;进化变体EvoPrompt(Guo等人,2024年)和Powerbreeder(Fernando等人,2023年)维持了即时人口;SPO(Xiang等人,2025年)通过使用LLM评价器对一对产出进行去除标签监督. 最近的调查(Ramnath等人,2025年)涵盖了该空间。 我们的循环以SPO为基础,但将LLM评价器替换为一个小的标签子集上的实际下游IR分数,并将该数字信号与以前尝试过的提示历史一起输入优化器LLM(§3.4)。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Framework Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 框架概览

Figure 1 illustrates the pipeline. The enriched query y ^ \hat{y} is passed as-is to a BM25 retriever, and the passage corpus is used unmodified. blocks.en: 3.4 Task-Grounded Automatic Prompt Optimization
blocks.zh: 3.4 任务组合自动快速优化

blocks.en: Hand-crafting prompts for each LLM at each stage does not scale as one adds more models or moves to new model families. We remove this bottleneck by wrapping every (stage, model) pair with a task-grounded APO loop, applied to (a) each generator’s prompt P i P_{i} in Stage 1 and (b) the ensemble prompt P e P_{e} in Stage 2.
blocks.zh: 每个阶段每个LLM的手工制作提示不会因为增加更多模型或移动到新的模型家庭而规模化. 我们用基于任务的 APO 环绕来包装每一对(阶段、模型),从而消除这一瓶颈,应用到(a) 第1阶段每个生成器的提示 P i P_{i}和(b) 第2阶段的组合 提示 P e P_{e}。

blocks.en: We build on Self-Supervised Prompt Optimization (SPO) ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) , a recent APO framework in which an optimizer LLM iteratively rewrites a prompt while an evaluator LLM decides which prompt to keep by comparing pairs of outputs. SPO does not require ground-truth labels because its evaluator is itself an LLM judge. This makes SPO attractive as a starting point but leaves open a well-known concern for ensemble settings: an LLM judge introduces its own biases and its evaluation signal is only loosely coupled to the ultimate downstream metric one cares about.
blocks.zh: 我们以自我监督的快速优化(SPO)(Xiang等人,2025年)为基础,这是最近一个APO框架,其中优化的LLM迭代重写一个提示,而评价的LLM则决定通过比较一对产出来迅速保持. SPO不需要地面真实标签,因为其评估者本身是LLM法官. 这使得SPO作为一个起点具有吸引力,但对综艺设置留下了众所周知的关注:LLM法官引入了自己的偏见,其评价信号只是松散地与人们所关心的最终下游度量结合.

blocks.en: For MERGE, the downstream metric we care about is retrieval quality, and it is cheap to measure. We therefore replace SPO’s LLM evaluator with the actual downstream IR task: each candidate prompt is scored by running the corresponding stage end-to-end on a fixed 20% subset of the training data and measuring nDCG@10 with the same fixed BM25 retriever used at test time. This gives the optimizer a task-grounded numerical signal rather than the pairwise LLM-judged preference used in vanilla SPO.
blocks.zh: 对MERGE来说,我们所关心的下游衡量标准是检索质量,而衡量成本低廉. 因此,我们用实际的下游IR任务取代SPO的LLM评价员:每个候选者通过在固定的20%的训练数据子集上运行相应的阶段端到端并用测试时使用的相同的固定BM25检索器测量nDCG@10来获得分数。 这使优化者获得基于任务的数字信号,而不是香草SPO中使用的双向LLM判断偏好.

blocks.en: Rather than accepting or rejecting a single new prompt per round, each round of our APO loop is framed as a small tournament (Algorithm 1 ). Two LLM roles are involved: a generator G G that produces query-expansion sets from a prompt, and an optimizer O O that rewrites prompts. The tournament tracks tuples of the form (expansion set, retrieval score, prompt-of-origin). In round 0, G G samples two expansion sets A , B ∼ G ⁡ ( P 0 ) A,B\sim G(P^{0}) from the hand-crafted seed prompt P 0 P^{0} , each is scored on the evaluation subset via the fixed retriever R R , and the higher-scoring tuple becomes the initial champion ( C , s C , P C ) (C,s_{C},P^{C}) with P C = P 0 P^{C}=P^{0} . From round t ≥ 1 t\geq 1 onwards, O O first rewrites the champion prompt into a new draft P t = O ⁡ ( P C , evidence t ) P^{t}=O(P^{C},\text{evidence}_{t}) , then G G samples two expansion sets A , B ∼ G ⁡ ( P t ) A,B\sim G(P^{t}) from P t P^{t} , and the highest-scoring tuple among the two challengers and the incumbent champion becomes the new champion. When a challenger wins, the champion tuple is replaced entirely (expansion, score, and prompt). Drawing two expansions per prompt rather than one exposes more of what a prompt can produce under stochastic decoding, guards against early convergence to a champion whose lead came from a single lucky decode, and forces challengers to clear a stricter bar before they can unseat the incumbent. We treat the loop as converged when the champion survives two consecutive rounds without being beaten, signalling that the optimizer has run out of profitable edits, and return P ∗ = P C P^{*}=P^{C} .

blocks.en: Our APO loop delivers three benefits that are essential for a multi-LLM ensemble like MERGE. (1) Scalability across LLMs. Adding a new generator no longer requires a human to hand-tune its prompt; the tournament produces a model-specific prompt automatically. (2) Cost. The dominant cost of MERGE at inference time is running many LLMs; hand-tuning prompts on top of this is a hidden but substantial developer cost. APO amortizes this cost into a one-off optimization phase whose budget the user can control. (3) Consistency. Because every prompt is optimized against the same retrieval-driven objective, prompts across the ensemble are tuned against a common yardstick, which makes the Stage-2 ensemble output more predictable.
blocks.zh: 我们的APO循环提供了三种好处,对于MERGE这样的多LLM综艺节目至关重要. (1) 跨地方政府的可扩展性。 添加新的生成器不再需要人手调整它的速率;锦标赛会自动生成一个模式专用的速率. (2) 费用。 MERGE在推论时的主要成本是运行许多LLMs;除此之外,手动调制提示是隐蔽但大量的开发者成本. APO将这笔费用摊销到一次性优化阶段,用户可以控制其预算. (3)一致性. 因为每个提示都是根据相同的检索驱动目标优化的,所以跨综艺的提示会根据一个共同的尺度来调制,这使得阶段-2综艺输出更具有可预测性.

blocks.en: 3.5 Dual-Level Ensemble
blocks.zh: 3.5 双重层次组合

blocks.en: MERGE operates ensemble at two complementary levels ( Dietterich, 2000 ) . Horizontally , Stage 1 aggregates heterogeneous LLMs that differ in architecture, training data, and scale—analogous to bagging, where diversity among base learners reduces variance and mitigates single-model blind spots. Vertically , Stage 2 specializes in synthesis (filtering hallucinations and merging complementary information into one compact expansion)—analogous to stacking, where a meta-model integrates base predictions. APO acts orthogonally to both levels, tuning how each model plays its role without changing the overall dual-level structure.
blocks.zh: MERGE在两个相辅相成的层次上开展共同行动(Dietrich,2000年)。 横向而言,第一阶段汇总了在结构、培训数据和规模方面有差异的各种法学硕士学位,这与包学不同,基础学习者的多样性减少了差异,减少了单一模式的盲点。 垂直来说,第2阶段专门从事合成(过滤幻觉和将互补信息合并到一个紧凑的扩展)——类似堆叠,其中元模型融合了基础预测. APO在正统上演到两个层面,在不改变整体双层结构的情况下,调整每个模式如何发挥作用.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: We evaluate on five heterogeneous BEIR ( Thakur et al., 2021 ) benchmarks spanning open-domain QA (NQ ( Kwiatkowski et al., 2019 ) ), scientific-claim retrieval (SciFact ( Wadden et al., 2020 ) ), financial opinion retrieval (FiQA ( Maia et al., 2018 ) ), argument retrieval (Touché-2020 ( Bondarenko et al., 2020 ) ), and entity retrieval (DBPedia ( Hasibi et al., 2017 ) ). This suite covers markedly different domains, query styles, and passage-length regimes. MERGE (with APO-tuned prompts) is applied to all queries; each passage corpus is left unmodified. Following BEIR conventions we report nDCG@10.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了跨越开放领域QA(NQ(Kwiatkowski等人,2019年)),科学-索赔检索(SciFact(Wadden等人,2020年)),财务意见检索(FiQA(Maia等人,2018年)),论点检索(Touche-2020(Bondarenko等人,2020年))和实体检索(DBPedia等人,2017年)的五项不同基准。 这个套装套装涵盖显著不同的域,查询风格,以及通道长度的制度. MERGE(带有APO调制的提示符)适用于所有查询;每个通过符没有修改. 根据贝鲁特公约,我们报告nDCG@10。

blocks.en: Stage 1 uses three 7–8B instruction-tuned models from three different families— Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen Team, 2024 ) , Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( AI@Meta, 2024 ; Touvron et al., 2023 ) , and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 ( Jiang et al., 2023a ) —keeping the pool at a comparable scale so no single generator dominates by size while different pretraining regimes provide the horizontal diversity Stage 2 exploits. Stage 2 uses Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct ( Qwen Team, 2024 ) , which is also the APO optimizer. All methods share a fixed BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) backbone, matching the standard setup for LLM-based query expansion ( Wang et al., 2023a ; Gao et al., 2023 ) so that measured gains reflect how the query is manipulated rather than a jointly trained retriever. LLM inference uses vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) on NVIDIA H100 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 第1阶段使用三个不同家庭的3个7-8B教学调整模型—— Quen2.5-7B-Instruct(Quen Team,2024年),Meta-Llama-31-8B-Instruct(AI@Meta,2024年;Touvron等人,2023年),以及Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3(Jiang等人,2023a年)——保持水池的可比规模,因此没有单个发电机按大小占主导地位,而不同的预训制度则提供横向多样性第二阶段的利用。 第2阶段使用Quen2.5-14B-Instruct(Quen Team,2024),这也是APO的优化器. 所有方法共用一个固定的BM25(Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009)骨干,匹配基于LLM的查询扩展的标准设置(Wang et al., 2023a); Gao et al., 2023),因此,所测得的收益反映了查询是如何被操纵的,而不是联合训练的检索器. LLM推论在NVIDIA H100 GPU上使用vLLM(Kwon等人,2023年).

blocks.en: For MERGE with APO, we report both variants introduced in § 3.4 : MERGE (APO) , the default tournament optimizer, and MERGE (APO w/ history) , the history-augmented variant.
blocks.zh: 对于与APO的MERGE,我们报告在3.4节中引入的两个变体:默认的锦标赛优化者MERGE(APO)和历史强化变体MERGE(APO w/历史).

blocks.en: All experiments rely on publicly available BEIR benchmarks and open-source model checkpoints (Qwen2.5-7B/14B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3) with a fixed BM25 backbone. The APO tournament (Algorithm 1 ), the two APO variants (§ 3.4 ), the seed-prompt design (§ 3.4 ), and the 20% dev-subset scoring protocol are fully described in the paper. Because MERGE requires only these public inputs and a lexical retriever with standard hyperparameters—no supervised training data, no proprietary corpus, no learned ranker—the results in Tables 1 and 2 can be independently reimplemented from the descriptions given here. Following widely used BM25 practice, we repeat the original query several times and append the enrichment as the retrieval input.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都依赖于公开的BEIR基准和开源模式检查站(Quen2.5-7B/14B-Instruct,Llama-31-8B-Instruct,Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3),并有固定的BM25主干线. APO锦标赛(英语:Algorithm 1 ),两个APO变体(§3.4),种子即时设计(§3.4),以及20%的dev-subset评分协议在论文中全面描述. 由于MERGE只要求这些公共投入和一个具有标准超参数的词典检索器——没有监督的培训数据,没有专利,没有学到的分级仪——表1和表2中的结果可以从这里的描述中独立地重新执行. 遵循广泛使用的BM25惯例,我们多次重复原始查询,并附上浓缩作为检索输入.

blocks.en: Across all five datasets, MERGE with APO improves BM25 nDCG@10 over the no-expansion reference. The absolute gain is largest where the original queries are furthest from the corpus vocabulary or style: + 14.9 +14.9 points on NQ (from 30.48 30.48 to 45.42 45.42 ), + 7.4 +7.4 on Touché-2020, + 6.0 +6.0 on DBPedia, and + 3.8 +3.8 on SciFact. On FiQA the gain is smaller but still positive ( + 2.1 +2.1 points, → 25.91 23.85\!\to\!25.91 ). This is consistent with MERGE closing a vocabulary/style gap on the query side, exactly where a lexical retriever like BM25 is most vulnerable.
blocks.zh: 在所有五个数据集中,使用APO的MERGE改进了BM25 nDCG@10的不扩展参考. 绝对增益最大的是原始查询最远离实体词汇或风格的:NQ上的+14.9+14.9分(从30.48分到45.4245.42分),Touché-2020上的+7.4+7.4分,DBPedia上的+6.0+6.0分,以及Scifact上的+3.8+3.8分. 在FiQA上,增益较小,但仍然为正值(+2.1+2.1分,~25.91 23.85\!to\!25.91). 这与MERGE关闭查询侧的词汇/风格漏洞一致,正是BM25这样的词典检索器最容易受到伤害的地方.

blocks.en: Compared with docT5query alone—a supervised, corpus-dependent baseline that runs T5 on every document—MERGE wins on all five benchmarks: + 7.3 +7.3 on NQ, + 3.9 +3.9 on SciFact, + 16.9 +16.9 on Touché-2020, and + 4.8 +4.8 on DBPedia; on FiQA the two are close (MERGE APO w/ history 25.91 vs. docT5query 25.20, a + 0.7 +0.7 win). Compared with BM25+Exp4Fuse, MERGE (in either APO variant) is better on all five datasets, with gains from + 0.5 +0.5 (Touché-2020) to + 6.3 +6.3 (NQ) points. Compared with the stronger stacked baseline docT5query+Exp4Fuse, MERGE wins clearly on NQ ( + 2.6 +2.6 ) and Touché-2020 ( + 11.8 +11.8 ), is essentially tied on SciFact ( + 0.1 +0.1 ), and loses narrowly on FiQA ( − 0.4 -0.4 ) and DBPedia ( − 1.0 -1.0 ). This is a favourable outcome: MERGE beats every unsupervised LLM-based query-expansion baseline on 5/5 benchmarks and matches or exceeds the strongest supervised baseline on 3/5, using only compact 7–8B open-source models, no supervised query–document pairs, and no access to the corpus.
blocks.zh: 仅与DocT5query相比,它是一个在每份文件上贯穿T5的受监督的、依赖实体的基线。 MERGE在所有五个基准上都取得了胜利:NQ上+7.3+7.3,Scifact上+3.9+3.9,Touché-2020上+16.9+16.9,DBPedia上+4.8+4.8;在FiQA上,两者接近(MERGE APO w/ history 25.91 vs. docT5query 25.20,一个+0.7+0.7胜负). 与BM25+Exp4Fuse相比,MERGE(无论是APO变体中的一种)在所有五个数据集上都较好,从+0.5+0.5(Touche-2020)到+6.3+6.3(NQ)点的增益. 与较强的堆叠基线docT5query+Exp4Fuse相比,MERGE在NQ(+2.6+2.6)和Toucé-2020(+11.8+11.8)上明显获胜,在Scifact(+0.1+0.1)上基本捆绑,在FiQA(−0.4-0.4)和DBPedia(−1.0–1.0)上损失很小. 这是一个有利的结果:MERGE在5/5的基准上击败了所有不受监督的基于LLM的查询-扩展基线,并在3/5的基准上匹配或超过最强的监管基线,只使用紧凑的7-8B开源模型,没有受监督的查询-文件配对,并且无法访问委托书。

blocks.en: Beyond raw retrieval numbers, MERGE is structurally simpler than the alternatives in Table 1 : docT5query is supervised and corpus-dependent (needs a labelled MS MARCO training set, runs T5 on every document, requires re-indexing when the corpus changes), and the Exp4Fuse variants add two BM25 passes and a reciprocal-rank-fusion step with tunable weights ( Liu and Zhang, 2025 ) . MERGE has none of these dependencies: its LLMs see only the user query, are used zero-shot, and produce an enriched query y ^ \hat{y} that is issued to a single BM25 pass over the original corpus. The only extra cost is the one-off APO tournament (§ 3.4 ), which typically converges in under 10 rounds per (stage, model) pair on a 20% dev subset (well under one hour on a single H100) and is amortized over all downstream retrieval traffic. This substitutes a small compute cost for the per-LLM manual prompt-engineering effort that would otherwise dominate as the model pool grows; empirically (Table 1 , M0 vs. M1/M2), that compute cost translates directly into large retrieval gains. Being corpus-agnostic also means MERGE can be applied at query time for online retrieval or offline as training-data augmentation for a downstream dense retriever, without changes when the corpus changes.
blocks.zh: 除了原始检索号码之外,MERGE在结构上比表1中的替代品简单:docT5query受到监督,并依赖生物体(需要贴标签的MS MARCO训练集,在每份文件上运行T5,在生物体变化时需要重新索引),Exp4Fuse变体增加了两个BM25通行证和一个与金枪鱼重量对应的对等级合并步骤(刘和张,2025年)。 MERGE没有这些依赖性:它的LLMS只看到用户查询,被使用零拍,并产生一个浓缩查询y ^\ hat{y},该查询是发给一个单一的BM25通过原主文. 唯一的额外成本是一次性APO锦标赛(§3.4),通常每对(阶段,型号)在20%的dev子集上(每单H100上一个小时以下)在10轮以下汇合,并在所有下游检索流量中摊销. 这替代了每LLM手动即时工程的少量计算成本,否则会随着模型库的增长而占主导地位;从经验上(表1,M0对M1/M2),计算成本直接转化为巨大的检索收益. 生物量-不可知性还意味着,在查询时可以应用MERGE进行在线检索或离线,作为下游密集检索器的培训数据增强,当生物量变化时无需改变。

blocks.en: Comparing MERGE w/o APO (M0) against the two APO variants isolates the effect of prompt optimization. Without APO, seed prompts hurt retrieval on two out of five datasets: on FiQA ( − 4.4 -4.4 vs. vanilla BM25) and Touché-2020 ( − 5.5 -5.5 )% ; a mis-specified prompt can actively degrade BM25 by adding noisy terms. Adding APO turns those regressions into consistent gains across all five datasets, without requiring any additional manual engineering. Between M0 and the better APO variant we see gains of + 10.9 +10.9 (NQ), + 3.6 +3.6 (SciFact), + 6.5 +6.5 (FiQA), + 13.0 +13.0 (Touché-2020), and + 4.4 +4.4 (DBPedia) nDCG@10 points. This is important not only because the absolute gain is large but because it converts prompt tuning from a manual per-LLM step into an automatic one.
blocks.zh: 将MERGE w/o APO(M0)与两个APO变体进行比较,隔离了即时优化的效果. 如果没有APO,种子提示在五个数据集中有两个会伤害检索:FiQA(−4.4-4.4 vs. vanilla BM25)和Touché-2020(−5.5-5.5)%;一个指定错误的提示可以通过添加吵吵的术语来积极降解BM25. 增加APO将使这些回归变成所有五个数据集的一致收益,而不需要任何额外的人工工程。 在M0和较好的APO变体之间,我们看到增益为+10.9+10.9(NQ),+3.6+3.6(Scifact),+6.5+6.5(FiQA),+13.0+13.0(Touche-2020),+4.4+4.4(DBPedia)nDCG@10分. 这一点很重要,不仅因为它的绝对增益很大,而且因为它将每个LLM步骤的手动快速调音转换为自动调音.

blocks.en: The two APO variants trade off in a query-dependent way. MERGE (APO) is stronger on precise factoid/entity queries (NQ 45.42 45.42 vs. 42.50 42.50 ; SciFact 71.40 71.40 vs. 70.01 70.01 ; DBPedia 37.94 37.94 vs. 37.84 37.84 ), while MERGE (APO w/ history) is stronger on broader, multifaceted queries (Touché-2020 51.67 51.67 vs. 50.16 50.16 ; FiQA 25.91 25.91 vs. 25.59 25.59 ). We hypothesize that feeding the last five rounds of the tournament back to the optimizer helps in domains where useful expansions require exploring a wider space of phrasings (financial and argumentative queries), while on entity-centric queries the extra history noise can distract from the direct win/loss signal.
blocks.zh: 两个APO变体以查询依赖的方式进行交换. MERGE(APO)在精确的事实/实体查询上更强(NQ 45.42 45.42 vs 42.50 42.50;SciFact 71.40 71.40 vs 70.01 70.01;DBPedia 37.94 37.94 37.84 37.84 /s 37.84 37.84),而MERGE(APO w/历史)在更广泛的多方面查询上更强(Touché-2020 51.67 51.67 vs 50.16 50.16; FiQA 25.91 25.91 25.59 25.59 ),我们假设将最后五轮联赛回馈给优化者,有助于在有益的扩展需要探索更广泛的措辞空间的领域(财务和论证性查询),而在实体中心查询上,历史以外的噪音可以分散对直接赢/损失信号的注意力。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation: Both Stages Contribute
blocks.zh: 4.3 偏差:两个阶段都有贡献

blocks.en: Table 2 isolates the contribution of the Stage-2 ensemble by comparing every individual Stage-1 generator’s enriched query against the final MERGE output, on three representative benchmarks (NQ, SciFact, FiQA). To keep the comparison apples-to-apples, all rows use the default APO variant ( MERGE (APO) ) and the same BM25 retriever; the only thing that varies is whether the query fed to BM25 is a single Stage-1 model’s expansion or the Stage-2 ensemble of all three.
blocks.zh: 表2根据三个有代表性的基准(NQ、SciFact、FiQA),将每个单独的Stage-1生成器的丰富查询与最后的MERGE产出进行比较,从而孤立了阶段-2组合的贡献。 为了保持苹果对苹果的比较,所有行都使用默认的APO变体(MERGE(APO))和相同的BM25检索器;唯一不同的是提供给BM25的查询是单个Space-1型号的扩展还是全部三个的Spage-2综艺.

blocks.zh: 表2:对两阶段建筑效果的影响. nDCG@10(%)带有BM25主干线;所有方法都使用MERGE(APO)(M1). 第1至第3行:BM25为单一的Stage-1型号提供了扩展. 第4行:BM25为阶段二综艺扩展配音.

We show the enriched query produced under the three APO regimes and its BM25 nDCG@10 on the NQ evaluation split. M0 uses the hand-crafted seed prompt; M1 and M2 use tournament-optimized prompts without / with a 5-round history.

We show the three Stage-1 candidates (one per LLM in the pool) and the Stage-2 ensemble output, all under MERGE (APO). “Score” is BM25 nDCG@10 on the NQ evaluation split. Long enrichments are elided as “…” but no substantive content is added.
blocks.zh: 表4:第二阶段对NQ问题“Cuban反抗Spain的导师”的影响。 我们显示三个阶段一的候选者(池内每个LLM一个)和阶段二的综艺产出,都列在MERGE(APO)之下. “分数”是NQ评价分数中的BM25 nDCG@10。 长期浓缩被称作“......”,但没有增加实质性内容。

blocks.en: Two observations. First, all three Stage-1 models with APO already improve BM25 over the original query, but the gain varies noticeably across models (e.g. on NQ, Llama beats Qwen by more than 6 6 nDCG@10 points). Second, the Stage-2 ensemble strictly dominates the best individual Stage-1 model on all three datasets, adding + 4.4 +4.4 (NQ), + 0.9 +0.9 (SciFact), and + 0.6 +0.6 (FiQA) nDCG@10 on top of the best Stage-1 candidate. This confirms that both stages contribute to retrieval quality: Stage 1 provides diverse candidates, and Stage 2 extracts more than any single generator does alone. The MERGE w/o APO row in the main table complements this ablation by isolating the effect of the APO loop itself.
blocks.zh: 二观察. 首先,所有三个带有APO的Stage-1模型已经比最初的查询改进了BM25,但增益因模型而异(例如在NQ上,Llama击败Quen的得分超过6个nDCG@10分). 其次,Stage-2综艺节目在全部三个数据集上都严格主导最佳个人Stage-1模式,在最佳Stage-1候选节目中,新增+4.4+4.4(NQ),+0.9+0.9(SciFact),+0.6+0.6(FiQA)nDCG@10. 这证实这两个阶段都有助于提高检索质量: 第1阶段提供不同的候选人,第2阶段的摘录比任何单一发电机都多。 主表中的MERGE w/o APO行通过隔离APO循环本身的效果来补充这种衰减.

blocks.en: 4.4 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 定性分析

blocks.en: We illustrate the two levers introduced by MERGE with real enrichments from our runs. Table 3 ( APO effect ) fixes a single query and a single Stage-1 model and shows how the enrichment evolves as we move from no APO (M0) through the two APO variants (M1, M2). Table 4 ( Ensemble effect ) fixes MERGE (APO) and shows, for two representative queries, all three Stage-1 candidates and the Stage-2 ensemble output. Long enrichments are elided as “…” but no substantive content is added.
blocks.zh: 我们用从我们运行中得到的实际财富来说明MERGE引入的两个杠杆. 表3(APO效果 )固定了单一查询和一个单一阶段-1模型,并显示随着我们从没有APO(M0)到两个APO变体(M1,M2)的移动,浓缩是如何演变的. 图表 4(集成效应 ) 修补 MERGE(APO),并显示两个具有代表性的询问,所有三个阶段-1的考生和阶段-2的综艺产出. 长期浓缩被称作“......”,但没有增加实质性内容。

blocks.en: Table 3 illustrates why APO helps: the seed prompt (M0) produces a bare entity list that loses BM25 signal, while tournament-optimized prompts (M1, M2) pair the same entities with retrieval-friendly context (movements, dates)—exactly what BM25 needs to match relevant Wikipedia passages. Table 4 makes the horizontal diversity across Stage-1 models visible: Mistral supplies date ranges ( 1868–1898 ), Llama supplies the key entity ( José Martí ) with biography, and Qwen contributes almost nothing useful (score 34.59 34.59 ). The Stage-2 ensemble fuses the useful signals ( Martí , Gómez , Maceo , 1868–1898 , ideological vs. military leadership) into a single enrichment and reaches 45.42 45.42 , outperforming every individual Stage-1 output. These patterns align with Table 1 : APO without history wins on precise entity queries (NQ) by preserving entity focus, while APO w/ history wins on exploratory queries (Touché-2020, FiQA) by broadening the expansion space.
blocks.zh: 表3说明了为什么APO的帮助:种子提示(M0)产生一个失去BM25信号的裸实体列表,而锦标赛-优化提示(M1,M2)则将相同的实体配以便于检索的上下文(移动,日期)——准确的说BM25需要匹配相关的维基百科段落. 表4显示第一阶段模型的横向多样性: Mistral供应日期范围(1868–1898年),Llama提供关键实体(José Martí)的传记,Quen几乎无济于事(34.5934.59分). " 第二阶段 " 组合将有用的信号(马蒂、戈麦斯、马塞奥、1868–1898、意识形态与军事领导)导引为单一的浓缩,达到45.42 45.42, 超过每个阶段-1的产出。 这些模式与表1一致:没有历史的APO通过保留实体焦点在精确的实体查询上获胜(NQ),而APO w/历史通过扩大扩展空间在探索查询上获胜(Touche-2020,FiQA).

blocks.en: Two properties of the APO loop itself are worth flagging. Convergence. Most tournaments hit the two-consecutive-wins termination in fewer than 10 rounds across models and datasets, which is what keeps the one-off APO cost small in practice. Optimizer-discovered prompts. For some Stage-1 models the converged prompt is substantially longer than the seed and, while composed of real English words, reads more as a bag of model-specific steering tokens than as a natural-language instruction—a common by-product of optimizing prompts directly against a downstream metric rather than against human readability. Importantly, the query enrichments those prompts produce remain readable (Tables 3 – 4 ), so this does not affect end-to-end usability.
blocks.zh: APO循环本身的两个属性值得标注. 相会. 多数联赛以不到10轮的跨模式和数据集命中两连胜的终止赛,这在实际操作中使得一次性APO成本很小. 乐观者发现的提示。 对于一些Page-1模型来说,聚合的速率大大长于种子,虽然由真实的英语词组成,但读起来更多是一包模型特定方向符号,而不是自然语言的指令——这是对下游指标而不是对人类可读性进行最优化的速率的常见副产品。 重要的是,这些促销产品的查询丰富度仍然可以读取(表3-4),因此不影响端到端的可用性。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented MERGE, a two-stage LLM-ensemble framework for query enrichment that couples three heterogeneous 7–8B generators with a 14B generative ensemble step, and integrated a task-grounded Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO) loop into both stages: each prompt is scored by BM25 nDCG@10 on a 20% dev subset, and a small tournament between the current champion and two optimizer-proposed drafts terminates when the champion survives two consecutive rounds; a history-augmented variant additionally feeds the last five rounds back to the optimizer. On five BEIR benchmarks with a shared BM25 backbone, MERGE improves nDCG@10 over the original queries on all five datasets (up to + 14.9 +14.9 on NQ), outperforms BM25+Exp4Fuse on every benchmark, and matches or exceeds the stronger docT5query+Exp4Fuse baseline on 3/5—using only compact open-source models and no supervised query–document pairs. Ablations show that the Stage-2 ensemble strictly dominates the best Stage-1 model and that task-grounded APO turns − 4 -4 to − 5 -5 point seed-prompt regressions into consistent gains without manual tuning, converting per-LLM prompt engineering from a manual step into an automatic one. Because MERGE is corpus-agnostic, y ^ \hat{y} can also feed a dense retriever (at inference or as training-data augmentation), and the same two-stage ensemble could be extended to passage-side enrichment as in doc2query ( Nogueira et al., 2019 ) or BEATS ( Shih et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们提出了MERGE, 一个两阶段LLM-共聚式的查询浓缩框架, 将三台不同7-8B的发电机和14B的基因组合步骤结合在一起, 并将一个基于任务的自动快速优化循环(APO)整合到两个阶段:每台由BM25 nDCG@10在20%的dev子集上打分, 本届冠军与两个优化者提议的草案在冠军连续两轮存活后结束的小型比赛; 一个历史赋予的变体将最后五轮反馈给优化者。 在拥有共享的BM25主干线的五个BER基准上,MERGE将nDCG@10改进于所有五个数据集的原始查询(最多+14.9+14.9在NQ上),超越每个基准的BM25+Exp4Fuse,并在3/5上匹配或超过更强的docT5query+Exp4Fuse基线——只使用紧凑的开源模型,没有监督的查询-文件配对. 缩写显示,Stage-2综艺严格主导了最好的Stage-1模式,基于任务设定的APO将−4-4转至−5-5点种子速率回归到不进行手动调试的一致增益,将每个LLM的提示工程从手动步骤转换为自动步骤. 由于MERGE是命题不可知的,y ^\hat{y}也可以喂养密集的检索器(推论或作为训练数据增强),与doc2query(Nogueira等人,2019年)或BEATS(Shih等人,2026年)一样,同一两阶段的综艺可以扩展到通过侧浓缩。
